thread:
noah_sales: Hey team — ORA Financial procurement asked for an assurance packet for the upcoming POC. Requested items: redacted SOC2 AOC, ISO27001 certificate excerpt, signed pen-test attestation (they provided a short template), and a one-page network diagram. They want everything within 8 business days. Who can own this?

rachel_security: We can produce redacted SOC2 AOC + ISO excerpt. For the pen-test attestation we need the exact scope and whether Dedicated will be included. If they need unredacted docs we require an NDA.

devops_jen: If they plan to run active scans against our infra we need a scan window and CIDR list. Otherwise we prefer they upload results to a presigned bucket. I can create the bucket once scope is final. Example presign command I usually share:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/ora-fin/ora-poc-evidence.zip --expires-in 604800
```
I also need to know if they'll want a dedicated mini-pool for the POC (ops changes).

paul_eng: Dedicated mini-pool = additional provisioning and IP allowlist. Ballpark for a 2-week reserved mini-pool is ~+22% over hosted list (depends on GPU type). Also, if scans target container IPs we'll need a short maintenance window to avoid noisy telemetry affecting SLOs.

olivia_legal: I can sign the pen-test attestation on company letterhead. Two prerequisites: (1) final scope string (hostnames/CIDRs and whether Dedicated is in-scope), (2) a PO or a signed POC cover note referencing the engagement. Turnaround: 48-72 hours after those are provided. We do not sign indemnities; this will be an attestation only.

noah_sales: ORA sent a template in email and listed scope as "staging.ora-fin.com" and also asked to include "if Dedicated used, include pool.staging.redwood.io". They also asked for a contact name for Redwood.

rachel_security: Suggested scope wording for legal: "Scope: testing limited to staging.ora-fin.com and associated staging infrastructure for ORA POC. Production systems and customer data are out-of-scope. Dedicated pool included only if explicitly requested in PO." Approve?

olivia_legal: That language is acceptable. We'll not accept requests to scan production. If ORA refuses PO, a signed POC cover note from procurement is acceptable.

devops_jen: Created presigned evidence bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/ora-fin/ (expires in 7 days) — I left a note in the runbook about validators we run on uploads.

doc-bot: evidence: runbook draft uploaded to sharepoint: /evidence/runbooks/ora-fin-poc-runbook-v1.pdf :page_facing_up:

paul_eng: Operational note: if they ask for private peering we need 5 business days to schedule network changes and a maintenance window. If they accept uploads only, we can proceed faster.

noah_sales: I'll push for uploads-only and request a PO that references a 2-week Dedicated add-on price (if they pick Dedicated). Asking procurement now. ETA EOD.

rachel_security: Next steps: @noah_sales get final scope + PO or signed POC note. @olivia_legal will sign once provided. @devops_jen will keep bucket/runbook ready. @paul_eng will allocate ops window estimate if peering requested.

noah_sales: Thanks all — pinging ORA now. Will update this thread when I have PO or scope confirmation :thumbsup:
